name: Terry McMillan Presents
summary: Terry McMillan Presents is a banner for a series of original movies executive produced by the bestselling author Terry McMillan and produced by Lifetime. The movies, focus on the love and lives of African American women,

name: Haul Out the Holly
summary: For a neighborhood as renowned for its spectacular holiday displays as Evergreen Lane, the street has long been modest when it comes to Halloween.  But when fun and spooky new neighbors, Luna and Marvin move to the block, Emily, Jared and the rest of the HOA agree to get in on the seasonal fun and launch EverSCREAM Lane to fundraise for a local charity.  As the block pulls together to plan creepy contests, spine-chilling décor and a spooktacular carnival, new haunted hijinks ensue with Pamela, Ned, Mary Louise and the rest of the block. Through the process, Emily rediscovers the joys of the holiday that she and her late grandmother once cherished.

name: The Great Escapers
summary:
Ever wished you could go on holiday with the cast of Coronation Street, I'm A Celebrity…, The Chase or Loose Women? Well now you can, sort of…

The Great Escapers is a brand-new prime time series, which will take some of the nation's best known ITV faces and send them off on their very first holiday together. We know they've worked alongside each other for many years, but can they now holiday together? Let's see as they pack their bags, jet off to the sunshine and check in to their hotel. 

The Great Escapers will show the celebrities as we've never seen them before.

In each episode, three stars will compete to give their colleagues the best holiday experience they can. But will one star's dream day out prove to be another's worst nightmare?

Jet2holidays will have a friendly overseas customer helper on hand throughout the experience to help guide each celebrity with their activity choices. Will the celeb choose what they personally like or try to guess what their travel companions would prefer?

At the end of the trip, the three celebrities will vote for who put together the most memorable day and one of them will be crowned The Greatest Escaper.

name: Comme un poisson dans l'eau
summary:
The ocean has its stars - dolphins, sharks, Manta rays, whales - and then there are the others, the humble and the discreet, which can only get the limelight thanks to a Disney movie.

Yet, from the clown fish to the octopus, the lionfish to the cleaner fish, without of course omitting the coral, all these creatures are the essential characters of the riveting marine life theatre.

With its playful narration and exceptional HD footage, Comme un poisson dans l'eau brings a new vision of this underwater universe. You will discover the secrets of its inhabitants through a profusion of colours, shapes and behaviours.

name: Hell Teacher: Jigoku Sensei Nube
summary: Meisuke Nueno, aka "Nube," a psychic teacher with a demon hand, as he battles evil spirits and monsters to protect his students from supernatural threats.

name: Haunted Hotel
summary: A single mother of two struggles to run a haunted hotel with the help of her estranged brother, who is now one of the ghosts haunting the hotel and thinks the other ghosts have some pretty good ideas.

name: Testament
summary: The Book of Acts explosively reimagined in an alternate-modern era. A resurrection sparks a movement that turns the world upside down, spreading hope amid chaos. As the followers risk everything to preach the good news, the Temple races to silence them before the oppressive Imperium regime retaliates. But public miracles, unburied secrets, and fractured loyalties force both sides to confront the true cost of their choices.

name: Jeopardy!
summary: 2024 Danish version of the popular quiz show. Contestants are provided with the answers by the host, to which they would then have to supply the questions.

name: 5 mal 5
summary: 5 mal 5 was an German adaptation of the US game show Lingo. Two pairs played against each other in several rounds, where they had to guess a five-letter word in five attempts. If they failed, the letters contained in the word they were looking for were marked.

name: Ms. X
summary: Ms. X centres on a woman who teams up with an old high school friend to scare her cheating husband into staying faithful. However, when things turn (accidentally) homicidal, she becomes caught between the cops, the cartel, and a vicious PTA.

previousepisode.name: Till Death Do Us Part Two

name: Доктор Вера
summary: In 1941, Vera Treshnikova was the only doctor left in the city. Her hospital was under 24-hour surveillance by the Gestapo. In order to continue performing her medical duty, Vera pretended to collaborate with the fascists. The townspeople condemned her, but did not know that the girl was hiding a partisan movement center in the hospital.

name: Art of the Surge
summary: Unprecedented access inside the Donald Trump reelection campaign running up to November 2024.

name: Scooped Up by an S-Rank Adventurer!
summary: Lloyd is a white mage who was unexpectedly banished from a hero's party. Lost and uncertain, he crosses paths with an S-rank adventurer party in need of a white mage, and joins them. Little did anyone know, the hero's party would fall apart and Lloyd would rise to fame. This is a story about an unmatched support magic user, who believes himself to be ordinary, becoming an unstoppable adventurer.

previousepisode.name: Lloyd Is Aware He Lacks Power.

name: City the Animation
summary: This town, is not just a normal town. There's laughter, love and emotional moments. An unpredictable ordinary life presented by the residents. Exciting stuffs come one after another. Welcome to CITY.

name: With You and the Rain
summary: On a rainy day, Fuji meets a cute critter posing as a dog and offering an umbrella and a cue card that says, "Please take me home," and she can't resist. With this dog-poster's quirky charm and mysterious ways, life together becomes a heartwarming adventure of friendship and shared seasons.

previousepisode.name: I Can Hear the Sound of the Rain

name: Dazzling
summary: Qing Ye, who grew up in a big city, returns to her hometown of Zhazhating in her senior year of high school due to family changes. There, she meets young people like Xing Wu. Despite facing various challenges in life and studies, Qing Ye overcomes them and helps Xing Wu, Cao Ping, Huang Mao, and others find their life goals. After graduating from college, Qing Ye and Xing Wu reunite in Zhazhating. This time, they not only achieve their life dreams but also find love with each other.

name: Heated Rivalry
summary: Two hockey players must decide if there is room in their fiercely competitive world for real love.

name: The Tom Green Farm
summary: Tom Green's Funny Farm, a high-energy show where the legendary comedian engages guests in extended, magazine-style interviews from his farm in rural Ontario.

name: Slo Pitch
summary: Welcome to the world of beer league sports, where Joanne Pico is coach to six-time league losers, "The Public Lass Brovaries." Coach Joanne is dead set on turning things around this season despite having just been brutally dumped by her girlfriend and co-founder of the team. Throughout the summer, Joanne leads her lovable, chaotic crew through a season of strikeouts, petty rivalries, conservative-politician sponsors, and sexy carwash fundraisers gone wrong. With her ex now playing on a rival team, Joanne's got a lot to prove this season. It's time to win the breakup, get the gang back together, and maybe even find new love over beers in the dugout.

name: Make Yourself Over
summary: Competition series Make Yourself Over, sees contestants attempt to create iconic looks, flipping the makeover format on its head.

name: Temptations Under the Sun: Cyprus
summary: Based on Québec's hit unscripted series OD : tentations au soleil, Temptations Under the Sun: Cyprus brings together Canada's most daring singles as they face seductive challenges and unexpected twists under the Mediterranean sun. The stakes are high as contestants earn points to unlock key advantages…but only the boldest and most compatible couple makes it to the end and returns home with an impressive cash prize.

name: OD : tentations au soleil
summary: OD : tentations au soleil takes flight on Crave with former single contestants from OCCUPATION DOUBLE known for their strong personalities. They take part in lascivious challenges, daring missions, and tropical getaways. Only one couple will return from this game of seduction with suitcases heavier by $25,000. Flirting, strategy, and bickering are to be expected!

name: Hockey Fanatics
summary: Hockey Fanatics hosted by Dave Foley as he gets up close and personal with celebrity hockey fans including Mike Myers, Jason Priestley, and Wynonna Judd.

name: Sigil
summary: A new eight-part fantasy-horror series that blends live action and animation into a mind-bending and exhilarating spectacle.

name: Seoul Palace
summary: In the early 1970s, an exiled Korean rock star, Lee Sang-Bin, seizes a path to redemption and relevancy when he's serendipitously charged with running the first Asian nightclub in Toronto.

name: Vie$ de rêve
summary: We follow the DREAM LIVES of six outgoing, confident, and wealthy Quebec women. Between Montreal, Miami, and Greece, they share their reality filled with glam, diamonds, and haute couture. There's no shortage of action or champagne!

previousepisode.name: On continue à vivre notre vie de rêve!

name: Wakacyjne Zbrodnie
summary: Wakacyjne Zbrodnie is a program presenting the stories of Poles whose dream vacation turned into a nightmare. When packing their bags, no one expects that the long-awaited vacation will end tragically.

name: Rhacsyn a'r Goeden Hud
summary: Magic and wizardry for young children from Rhacsyn and his friends!

name: Boys Vibe The Project
summary: A reality show that will take everyone to experience the cuteness of 10 boys. To find love, friendship and wonderful memories that are truly unique to each other after living together for over 2 weeks.

name: Real Love
summary: A romance between a student and his teacher. Where will their journey take them?

name: Lleifior
summary: An adaptation of the two popular novels "Cysgod y Cryman" and "Yn ol i Leifior" by Islwyn Ffowc Elis.

name: Ti Fi a Cyw
summary: Adults and children learn Welsh together.

name: Oh, Otto!
summary: When Otto's boyfriend Boris dumps him and his best friend Lente leaves town, he decides to fill his heart with fleeting online love and goes in search of his place within the Brussels queer scene.

name: Disc a Dawn
summary: Pop music show

name: Butchers of L.A.
summary:
Butchers of L.A. sheds new light on the horrifying crimes of the "Freeway Killers" who terrorized Southern California over two decades.

From the early 1970s, gay men were being savagely murdered and their bodies carelessly discarded along Southern California's highways. Initially, police suspected a single perpetrator, but the detectives' investigation ultimately revealed that three killers were operating, independently of each other, in the same vicinity. With intertwined storylines and dramatic twists and turns throughout, Butchers of L.A. exposes three sadistic serial killers — Patrick Kearney, William Bonin, and Randy Kraft — and explains the truth behind these horrifying events.

name: Trainwreck
summary: 8-part documentary anthology that focuses on some of the wildest and most bizarre events ever to blow up in mainstream media. Each week, tune in to a new story told from the perspective of those at the heartbeat of the chaos. Opening with the tragedy of the 2021 Astroworld Festival, the series then ranges from political scandals and media hoaxes to cult-like corporations and reality TV disasters. Trainwreck delves into the stories the world could not look away from.

name: 9 Years of You
summary: From once-close friends who knew each other better than they knew themselves, a turbulent nine-year love story unfolds between Nubdao and Run.

name: Hooligans
summary: Meni Azulai, who arrives at Teddy Stadium every Saturday with a supermarket cart. Not for the game itself, Meni isn't even a football fan. He's a lone wolf with an explosive temperament. Though the game doesn't interest him, when he saves a man who turns out to be the leader of the club's radical fan organization, the police force him to become an undercover agent against his will.

name: Dinner and a Movie
summary: Married for over 15 years, Biggs and Mollen will bring their shared love of film and food to TBS fans every Saturday night with a can't-miss party that includes fun games, delicious food and some of the biggest film blockbusters. Featuring a schedule of surprise guests, including a collection of familiar Food Network faces who will bring their cooking expertise and some delicious bites to share, "Dinner and a Movie" is a perfect blend of behind-the-scenes scoop and a potluck with friends.

name: Papá Soltero
summary: Papá Soltero tells the story of César, who becomes the sole caretaker of a unique family after the sudden death of his wife Sandra. His new reality includes his teenage stepdaughter Ana, his daughter from a previous marriage María, and the twins he had with Sandra — Miguel and Cesarín. Now, César must figure out how to be a father to them while navigating and discovering other aspects of his life.

name: Better Late Than Single
summary: Ready to step into the dating world, lifelong singles get expert help for style, health and confidence. Will they manage hiccups on their way to love?

name: Camino a Arcadia
summary: Pablo has it all—a quiet life, a close-knit community and a son he adores. As the coach of a youth Canarian wrestling team, he's known for his kindness and calm demeanor in the peaceful town of Arcadia. No one knows the truth about Pablo's dark, dangerous past. Once living on the edge in Mexico, he escaped his violent life to protect his son Bruno. Becoming a father changed everything for him—but running away from his old life came at a cost. His wife, who he left behind, has never forgiven him. Now she's back, ready to shatter the world he's built. As old secrets resurface and tension boils, Pablo is forced to confront his past. Can he protect his son and hold onto the paradise he created, or will his former life destroy everything he loves?

name: Soleil noir
summary: When a mysterious message lures young mother Alba to work at the Lasserre rose farm, her new job quickly spirals into murder and family revelations.

name: The Furry Detectives: Unmasking A Monster
summary: A riveting true crime docu-series, The Furry Detectives: Unmasking A Monster unpacks the 2018 event known in the Furry community as the "Furry Zoosadist Leaks," which exposed a horrifying conspiracy of animal abuse lurking beneath the Fandom's playful exterior. The series follows the pack of dedicated vigilantes who teamed up to bring down the monsters behind the masks. Navigating the line between amateur sleuthing and official police investigation, the Furry Detectives exposed a ring of animal abusers, fought for victims, and defended their community from the evil within.

name: Sam Witch
summary: Sam Witch follows the adventures of Sam, a young girl learning the ins and outs of being a witch. With the support of her family, friends and magical pets, Sam is excited to tackle problems big and small around town in her own "witchy way."

name: Miraculous Stellar Force
summary: Miraculous Stellar Force, the first original spin-off series in the Miraculous Universe showcasing 2D hand-drawn anime style animation, is set in an international school in Tokyo, where twelve students discover they are guardians of the shattered Stellar Matrix, an ancient cosmic weapon. Led by Miki, Mayotte, and Yu Lu, the team must overcome clashing personalities and chaotic friendships to unite against rising galactic threats – including the vengeful Modeler and the dark entity known only as The Supreme. The new series, to launch in 2027, will be introduced through a one-hour, high-octane special later this year where Marinette and Kagami play a pivotal role in rallying this fractured team of Tokyo-based heroes.

name: Play in a Day
summary: Newly graduated and deprived of opportunities, budding young performers backed by creative teams are given 24 hours to stage a 15-minute production.

name: Sign2Win
summary: Sign2Win is the BSL ZONE's first game show in BSL. Presented by Fifi Garfield, three teams will go head to head to win £1000. Over five rounds, the teams must rely on a mix of skills based on their BSL language from reaction and memory to Deaf culture knowledge, in a battle for the prize. Who will take home the prize?

name: Bloom Once More
summary: In the eighth year of Tianyuan, Yue Qianxue was framed and killed in the Battle of Luori City by spies Lu Qianqian and Lu Li from the rival kingdom of Ximu. One year after her death, Hua Qingming also failed to defend Changping Capital, plunging the world into chaos and widespread suffering. Unable to bear the devastation wrought upon the people, Zhuge Renfeng sacrificed his own lifespan and used the Donghuang Bell as a medium to send Yue Qianxue and Hua Qingming back in time to the sixth year of Tianyuan. From that moment on, their intertwined fates began a mission to save the world and change the course of destiny...

name: Botched Presents: Plastic Surgery Rewind
summary: Botched Presents: Plastic Surgery Rewind follows nine celebrities and social influencers through a transformative journey of self-discovery at the "Rewind Retreat," as they decide whether to reverse previous plastic surgeries and return to a more natural look. Through eye-opening challenges, unexpected emotional connections and laugh-out-loud moments, the participants are asked to look within while reassessing their concept of beauty.

name: BETH
summary: A miracle birth unravels a marriage and rocks the very foundation of humankind.

name: The Fallen Lady Returns
summary: Brutally murdered by the Zhous in her past life, Marchioness Ding'an Zhang Xiyin miraculously reincarnates! Bent on revenge against her husband, Marquis Ding'an Zhou Yihong, and his secondary wife, Li Yuewan, Zhang Xiyin takes the initiative to approach Prince Ji, Duan Jianli, allying for mutual benefit. Yet, through a series of encounters, unexpected sparks ignite between them, transforming their purely transactional relationship into something far deeper.

name: To Get Master
summary: When spoiled Princess Li Song'er of Zuimeng Kingdom transmigrates into Supreme Tyrant, she finds herself stuck with Gu Yuan, the story's merciless antagonist. Though she schemes to escape, fate has other plans—he's her only ticket home. Now, this cluelessly charming royal must outwit the devil himself... without losing her heart in the process.

name: Twin Fates
summary: It tells the story of Chi Yu, a Phoenix Divine Beast of the Scarlet Flame Clan who has locked away his heart and love. He encounters Mu Lingxue, a mortal girl whose family has been destroyed by treachery. On a night of the full moon, the two form a bond between human and beast, sealing a twin-soul contract. Through hardship and struggle they grow together. In the end, they eradicate traitors and save all living beings.

name: Bastard Wargod
summary: Chu Beichi, the Divine Warrior of Kunlun, fell into a coma saving the realm. Awakening in secret, he assumes the identity of a low-born son in the Chu Family. His rise defies all, restoring honor to his clan, crushing bloodthirsty bandits, and unraveling the legendary Cosmic Game. As empires tremble, he slays the treacherous chancellor and subdues ten thousand kingdoms, all while the Princess, Empress, Merchant Queen, and General vie for his heart. Now, the world bows before its true master.

name: My Friend Maisy
summary:
Following Maisy and her friends, Tallulah, Eddie, Charley and Cyril, on imaginative, joy-filled adventures. From flying a rocket to the moon and sliding down rainbows, to fixing cars in her garage and meeting stripey zebras, Maisy shows that with curiosity and kindness, anything is possible. Each episode bursts with inventive surprises and playful "lift the flap" moments designed to delight preschool audiences.

For decades, the Maisy books have captivated children with their endearing characters, charming, simple tales and vibrant art style. Like the popular books, the new series is full of vibrant colour, engaging stories and Lucy Cousins' cheeky characters. My Friend Maisy is a show for any time of day - before bed or during family together time on the couch.

name: Queer Lives Today
summary:
Together TV proudly presents the premiere of four films exploring queer lives in Britain today. Brought to you by Together TV's BAFTA-winning Diverse Film Fund, this year's storytellers include the aquatic adventures of two queer mermaids, the tumultuous tale of a trans boxer campaigning for the right to fight, Britain's first out Muslim drag queen undergoing gender affirmation surgery and the struggles of two gay dads going through the painful child adoption process.

How does somebody find their place in the world when they feel different to everyone around them? When don't they feel ‘normal' or that they don't ‘fit in'? These funny, raw, touching and honest voices from LGBTQ+ communities across the UK, explored with passion and heart from four exceptionally talented filmmakers, will take you on a journey of resilience and strength in the face of adversity as our protagonists seek to change hearts and minds in order to find acceptance within their communities.

name: Vanishing Point
summary:
Set in the shabby seaside town of Vanishing Point, the series follows a group of four teens, Ivy, Cole, Zefi and Splash, whose world is turned upside-down when their town is overrun by ordinary-looking objects with bizarre, hidden powers.

 With the help of Bernie, a grumpy junkyard owner who knows more than she lets on, the gang become unlikely heroes as they battle the curious objects, thought to have extra-dimensional power trapped inside.  

 They make a formidable team, secretly protecting the town from the dangers and mayhem of the supernatural objects. Meanwhile there are sinister inter-dimensional agents on a quiet mission to drain the town of its cosmic energy.

 From a fridge magnet that manipulates metal objects to cause chaos, or a bow tie which compels the wearer to reveal their innermost thoughts, every episode is a new adventure full of surprises, teamwork and fun.

name: Celebrity Sabotage
summary:
Joel Dommett, Judi Love, Sam Thompson and GK Barry, alongside a whole host of celebrities, get ready to shock the nation in a brand new ITV entertainment reality game show, Celebrity Sabotage.

Each week our gang of celebrity saboteurs will be joined by a NEW guest saboteur, including Jill Scott MBE, Fay Ripley, Olivia Attwood, Jo Brand, Guz Khan and Harry Redknapp. Who will join in on all the action and cause even more mischief and mayhem.

In each episode a fresh set of unsuspecting contestants will arrive, believing they're participating in a brand-new ITV show. These range from cooking challenges and relationship tests to business tasks and even murder mystery games. Little do they know that these shows are completely made up! To make it even more convincing, these fake shows will have believable hosts, including familiar faces such as Clare Balding, Matt and Emma Willis, Monica Galetti, Jason Fox, Sara Davies and Rylan Clark. Everyone involved, from the celebrity saboteurs and the crew to the famous hosts, is in on the secret.

The celebrities are hidden away in their very own high-tech mission HQ, secretly watching the contestants' every move. With props and disguises at their disposal, the question is: can the celebrities hold their nerve to successfully pull off some delightfully devious and convincingly cunning stunts, to win that big cash prize?  

The stakes are high for our celebrity saboteurs. Every successfully executed sabotage mission will add more money to a secret prize pot. At the end of each episode, this pot will be revealed and shared equally among all the contestants - a complete surprise for them!

name: Life And Soul
summary: Life and Soul discovers how people's faith, culture and community has impacted their lives.

name: Pase a la Fama
summary: Pase a la Fama, a Telemundo competition, seeks to find the next global regional Mexican band. Aspiring musicians from diverse backgrounds compete in a bootcamp-like setting, facing challenges, performances, and eliminations, vying for a $100,000 prize and a record deal with HYBE Latin America.

name: Miss Universe Latina, el reality
summary: Miss Universe Latina, el reality is an American reality television beauty pageant in which thirty contestants compete for the title Miss Universe Latina and represent U.S. Latinas at the 74th Miss Universe pageant.

name: Dousoukai
summary: This is the story of Onihara Natsuki, who is married to Ando Fuuma. During his high school days, Ando Fuuma was once in love with a schoolmate, Atari Kousuke. However, as Kousuke is straight, Fuuma tried his best to forget about him, by hanging out at Shinjuku 2-chome. Together with Kousuke's girlfriend's brother, Tanno Arashi, Fuuma has sexual orgies with partners of both sexes. Now, Ando Fuuma is married to Onihara Natsuki, who doesn't know that Ando is gay. One day, Natsuki accidentally found out that Ando is gay. In her despair, she sets out to Shinjuku 2-chome, wandering around aimlessly deep in the night. There, she bumps into Arashi, and had a one-night stand with him, after which Arashi demanded money from her. Soon after, Natsuki realises she is pregnant with Arashi's child. She abhors the thought of having a child from paid sex and is adamant to have an abortion.

name: Harmony Secret
summary: Maevika, the only heiress of Superior Group—one of the country's leading department store conglomerates—is a confident and self-assured young woman. But her confidence crumbles the day she loses to Aywarin, the only heiress of Orianna Group, one of the largest hotel empires in the nation, during a joint school project competition. Years pass, this time as leaders of their respective empires—competing head-to-head for the high-stakes Greater Duty-Free concession, a multi-billion project. Circumstances force them into close proximity, transforming their rivalry into an uneasy alliance. For Mae, this closeness becomes a strategy to uncover Ai's secrets and win the bid. But for Ai, it is the chance to get closer to the woman she has secretly loved since the day they met.

name: Drag Race Philippines: Slaysian Royale
summary: Filipino pride meets global drag excellence in the fiercest drag showdown of the year! Twelve dazzling queens battle for the crown to become the very first Slaysian Royalty. With next-level drama, jaw-dropping talent, and unapologetic Asian artistry, this season serves Asian representation like never before. Get ready to slay, the Slaysian Royale way!

previousepisode.name: Slaysian Grand T.I.T.E! (Totally Impressive Talent Extravaganza!)

name: Alene
summary:
10 experienced outdoor enthusiasts aged 21 to 62 are sent on a unique adventure – isolated in the Norwegian wilderness. Equipped only with a camera and simple fishing gear, each one is left to their own devices. 

The participants have no idea where they are going. Each one is transported to their own area around Altevatn, which is located 480 meters above sea level at the tree line in Troms county. Here they will set up camp, get enough food and cope with the loneliness. The participants film everything themselves and it is their comments and experiences that drive the story. When they can't take it anymore – they can ask to be taken home.

name: The Suzy Lamplugh Mystery
summary: When Suzy Lamplugh disappeared without a trace in 1986, many detectives had a suspect in mind but could never prove his guilt. Fresh evidence reveals astounding new details in one of the most baffling cases in recent history.

name: Fu Taitai De Majia You Yidian
106 & Sports
summary: 106 & Sports is a fast-paced, culture-forward countdown that breaks down the week's Top 10 moments in sports—from viral highlights and locker room soundbites to championship fits and trending topics. Each episode delivers a dynamic blend of athlete interviews, unfiltered commentary, and real talk that lives at the intersection of sports and Black culture.

name: The Fixer
summary: In The Fixer successful business investor and entrepreneur Marcus Lemonis puts his money to work and uses his signature 3 P's philosophy - People, Process, and Product - to empower businesses to thrive. In each episode, Lemonis meets with business owners from across the country whose companies are at a crossroad and need to make impactful changes. Struggling with tough decisions and looking for direction, he'll assess their prospects and pick one business in the hope that they will all make a profit. As they address extraordinary challenges together in a revealing behind-the-scenes journey to success, they will benefit from Marcus's candid instruction and business know-how in an effort to seek an investment.

name: Long Gu Fen Xiang
summary: Meng Qianzi, the Lord of the Mountain Spirits, and the mysterious man Jiang Lian embark on a fantastical adventure to unravel a thousand year old mystery.

name: Providence Falls
summary: In 1844 Ireland, Liam O'Conner, a rogue and a thief, falls in love with Cora McLeod, a fiery but sheltered aristocrat's daughter, who is promised in marriage to a man she barely knows. Their plan to make a new life together in America is thwarted, and the consequences of Liam and Cora's unlikely love ripples through time, causing everyone to relive the events of the past. Now the Angels of Destiny need Liam's help to set things right and if he doesn't succeed, his very soul is on the line.  They transport Liam to present day to help this incarnation of Cora fall in love with Finn, the man she was destined to marry in 1844.  Liam would give anything to reunite with his beloved Cora but only he retains the memories of their past together. Now a cop in Providence Falls, Oregon, Cora feels an inexplicable connection to Liam, who is introduced as her new partner. And as they tackle a big case together, Liam sees the same passion and adventurous nature in Cora that he had fallen in love with.  With everyone's lives at stake, Liam must overcome unexpected and otherworldly obstacles in his mission.  Perhaps none as powerful as his own undying love for Cora.

name: Jugando con fuego: España
summary: A group of flirty Spanish singles expect sun, parties and steamy hookups, but they quickly learn that winning €100,000 requires giving up sex completely.

name: Steven Universe: Lars of the Stars
summary: Steven Universe: Lars of the Stars explores the past, present and future of the Steven Universe universe. The sequel series follows Lars Barriga, eternal teenager and space outlaw, as he and his pirate crew smuggle contraband, evade the authorities, and uncover the darkest secrets of the fallen Gem Empire.

name: Evelyn Hamann's Geschichten aus dem Leben
summary: Popular comedian Evelyn Hamann appears in various tragicomic everyday dramas. Whether as a passionate zoo visitor fighting for the affection of her favourite elephant, as a naive housewife hired by a shady sales trainer as a "personal sales agent," or as an ungrateful advisor for a women's magazine - these are always roles that were tailor-made for the renowned actress.

name: Новый Ревизорро
summary: Elena Letuchaya announces the hunt for fraudsters! Each issue is a journalistic investigation devoted to fraud in different spheres of life. Medical institutions, veterinary clinics, car dealerships, catering outlets, services of magicians and psychics and many other things will be checked. Letuchaya will meet the fraudsters face to face and hold them to account.

name: Marked
summary: To save her daughter, a cash-in-transit vehicle security guard agrees to be the inside woman on a heist, but when she's betrayed, she'll become worse than any of her newfound enemies.

name: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
summary: The Cassidy Family saddle up for their biggest adventure yet - summer on Dino Island—a lost world filled with new dinosaurs, mysteries, and lessons in teamwork and bravery.

name: Shen Mi Shu Zen Hui Zhe Yang
In the Moonlight
summary: A fallen princess, forced into marriage and exiled, is saved by a celibate king devoted to the gods. One glance under the desert moon sparks a love that defies fate. Together, they face chaos, protect their land, and find solace in each other beneath the same bright moon.

name: The Curse of Huli Town
summary: A tranquil town is shattered by eerie events as a century-old horror resurfaces. A blood-written curse from a madwoman plunges the community into an abyss of despair. Within the thickening mist, do lurking shadows reveal the demons of the human psyche, or an elaborate man-made scheme?

name: Stealing Heart
summary: Tells the story of Lin Chuning, an orphaned girl in the Republican era, who mistakenly believes that her dear friend Xiaorou died at the hands of the playboy Lu Siyen. To take revenge, she disguises herself as the Lu family's daughter and assumes the role of Lu Siyen's twin sister, infiltrating the Lu household to carry out her plan.

name: Blade in the Shadows
summary: In the treacherous underworld of Republican-era Shanghai, communist operatives become human torches, burning bright to pierce the darkness. When underground agent Xiao Ke inherits a coded brooch from fallen comrade "Sparrow," betrayal thrusts him into a lethal game of cat and mouse. With renegade vigilante Liu Yunshan as his unlikely shield, they navigate coded qin melodies in ghost markets, outwit double agents at decoy evacuation points, and confront venomous betrayals veiled in camaraderie. Every twist in this high-stakes chess match exposes the razor's edge between sacrifice and salvation, where the brooch holds not just secrets, but the very soul of a revolution forged in blood and valor.

name: One Night in Idaho: The College Murders
summary: In the middle of the night on November 13th, 2022, four University students were brutally murdered in an off-campus house in the quiet college town of Moscow, Idaho. With exclusive and intimate access to figures closest to the victims, One Night in Idaho: The College Murders explores the emotional twists and turns of this American tragedy and its continued fallout.

name: 10 NEWS+
summary:
10 NEWS+ will follow Network 10's 5pm local news bulletins across the country, offering viewers extended context and deeper reporting on the day's biggest stories. The 5pm bulletin remains a cornerstone of the network's trusted news offering, delivering the latest breaking news and updates.

10 NEWS+ aims to redefine evening news by providing comprehensive analysis, trusted reporting, and long-form investigative journalism. The program will offer a fresh perspective on critical local and global stories, tailored for an engaged audience seeking in-depth news coverage.

At a time when misinformation is rife, 10 NEWS+ is steadfast in its commitment to truth and transparency, delivering journalism with integrity, clarity, and purpose.

Designed for Australia's evolving media landscape, 10 NEWS+ will integrate across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms, ensuring content is accessible and engaging for Australians everywhere.

The program will be anchored Sunday to Thursday by investigative journalist Denham Hitchcock and Walkley Award-winning journalist Amelia Brace, with Senior Journalist and respected news anchor Ursula Heger and National Affairs Editor Hugh Riminton leading coverage every Friday.

name: Footballers' Wives TV
summary: Footballers Wives TV is a spin-off mockumentary comedy series that was broadcast to tie-in with the original broadcast of the fourth series of Footballers Wives.

name: Footballers' Wives - Extra Time
summary: Just as their counterparts in Footballers' Wives, they are beautiful, filthy rich and can have anything money can buy. Meet Anika Beevor the sister of super-bitch Tanya Turner, if you thought Tanya was bad wait till you see Anika in action. Bruno is introduced to two teenage children he never knew he had, Amber says goodbye to Conrad and Seb falls for Yasmin, Bruno's teenaged Daughter.

name: La Frontera
summary: The year is 1987. France begins collaborating with Spain in the fight against ETA. A dissident group from the organization is about to commit an attack in Paris. The Spanish authorities have decided not to intervene, but a young captain of the Guardia Civil decides to act.

name: Скрытые мотивы
summary: In the center of events is a young woman Nina Pokrovskaya. At first glance, it may seem that everything in her life is developing in the best way. She is married to a good man. They have been together for sixteen years, and Nina has been feeling happy all this time. Together they bring up the stunning son Artyom. The husband of the main character, Ivan, is a very caring and loving man. He holds a fairly high post in the investigative department of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Russia. The main character is beautiful, well-groomed and full of strength. She has a favorite hobby, to which she tries to devote all her free time. She is interested in photography.

name: Bon Appétit, Your Majesty
summary: What happens when a Michelin-worthy chef from Paris accidentally time-slips to the Joseon dynasty? She meets the King, a fearsome tyrant with an unexpectedly refined palate. In a bid to survive palace intrigue and royal appetites, she whips up dazzling fusion dishes that tempt even the coldest heart. But as sparks fly in the royal kitchen, a slow-burn romance simmers beneath the surface.

name: 20 Stjerners Sommerferie
summary: Who is the ultimate summer strategist? Join the summer's funniest challenges!

name: Esports World Cup: Level Up
summary: Esports World Cup: Level Up follows the most ambitious Esports tournament ever staged—1,500 players, 22 titles, $60 million on the line. From rising prodigies to battle-tested legends, the race for the first-ever Club Championship unfolds in Riyadh. Just because something doesn't have a history… doesn't mean it can't be historic.

name: The Bible Revealed
summary:
The Bible remains a living document—interpreted across traditions, translated across millennia, and debated in every generation. From the mysteries of Genesis to the epic of Exodus, The Bible Revealed (w.t.) examines these enduring stories in a way that is immersive, informed, and emotionally powerful.

Through expert commentary from renowned scholars and premiere theologians, the series explores the foundational biblical events — such as the Great Flood, the Ten Plagues, and the Garden of Eden — through theological tradition, rigorous scientific inquiry and cultural resonance to deepen understanding of a book that has shaped so much of human history.

name: Christmas at Sea
summary: Christmas At Sea follows the journeys of various Hallmark fans aboard the network's inaugural Christmas cruise, showcasing the joy, connection, and community that define the Hallmark experience. The show features diverse groups of cruisers, including those celebrating significant life moments like a surprise proposal and wedding, or lifelong friends on a girls' trip, and more. The series also highlights celebrity guests, according to Southern Living. It's a joyful love letter to fans, capturing the magic of a Christmas cruise and the heartwarming stories it unfolds

name: Your Sunshine
summary: In the early 20th century, the Yins and the Lus were two prominent families in Tangcheng. As time went on, the Lu family fell into decline, and internal strife broke out within the Yin family. To escape mounting debts, the Lu family's younger daughter, Lu Ye, faked her death and fled abroad, while the elder daughter, Lu Yi, married Yin Zhuofeng—the second son of the Yin family—to protect the Lus. Years later, Lu Yi dies unexpectedly. Lu Ye returns from overseas to attend her sister's funeral and reunites with her former brother-in-law, Yin Zhuofeng. In the process, she uncovers a web of connections between Lu Yi's death and a mysterious organization known as Yixin Society. Determined to seek justice, Lu Ye becomes Yin Zhuofeng's disciple and joins Bronze Leaf, an underground group he leads. She vows to become a blade of vengeance. As the two spend more time together, feelings quietly blossom between master and disciple, and a long-buried secret crush gradually comes to light. As truths about Lu Yi's identity and the intertwined history of the Yin and Lu families are revealed, the two begin to unravel the mystery behind Yixin Society. After surviving numerous life-and-death trials, Feng and Ye ultimately find love and embark on a shared path of justice.

name: The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch: Behind the Gates
summary: The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch: Behind the Gates offers a more in-depth look at the mysteries surrounding the ranch and the team's investigations, often featuring interviews with team members and experts.

previousepisode.name: All Roads Lead to Skinwalker Ranch

name: Suoding Fafeng Xitong! Qing He Wo De Qianfu Jiehun ba
FeierAbend
summary: On the evenings of (Christian) holidays in Austria, this reportage series offers quarter-hour opportunities to engage with the spiritual aspects of the day off by means of portraits of religious people and reports on current events.

name: Furia
summary: A contemporary portrait around five women ready to do anything in the face of extreme situations such as extortion, oppression, deceit, exclusion or manipulation in a single shared universe articulated around five conflicts that will develop like a butterfly effect – one as a consequence of the other – and so on to shared catharsis.

name: The Casketeers: Life and Death Around the Globe
summary: Beloved funeral directors, husband-and-wife team Francis and Kaiora Tipene embark on a new travel odyssey, witnessing life and death traditions from Tonga, Japan, India and more.

name: Vendetta
summary: Vendetta follows the underworld investigations of ex-mafioso turned mafia-hunter Danny Scipio.

name: A l'instinct
summary: Teva Royer, a police lieutenant in Cayenne who is close to his feelings and without a filter, trusts his instincts blindly. Raised in a village in the heart of the Amazon, he survived alone in the jungle for seven months when he was just a child. No one knows what happened during those long weeks, but since then, no emotion, no hesitation, no movement escapes Teva.

name: Woobinda
summary: "WOOBINDA - ANIMAL DOCTOR" is an Australian series that primarily showcases the Australian bush, countryside, and its captivating wildlife. The story revolves around a veterinary surgeon who lives near an unnamed country town called Gatten's Creek. The series features appealing human characters, led by the titular animal doctor, John Stevens (played by Don Pascoe), along with his assistant, Peter Fischer (played by Lutz Hochstraate), who is of German descent. John Stevens has a teenage daughter named Tiggie (portrayed by Sonia Hoffman) and an adopted Aboriginal son, Kevin (played by Bindi Williams). He is also supported by an elderly retainer, Jack (portrayed by Slim De Grey). In keeping with television tradition, John Stevens is a widower, continuing the familiar trope in such series.

name: Gautes dokumentarprogram
summary: Gaute redefines himself as an investigative journalist. He digs into sandboxes, drains and why people don't like him.

name: Ghost Hunters of the Grand River
summary: Ghost Hunters of the Grand River follows a group of Six Nations ghost hunters who have dedicated their very existence to gathering evidence from the world of ghost stories, paranormal encounters and the unexplainable.

previousepisode.name: Peterborough Lift Lock National Historic Site

name: An Ghig Mhór
summary:
An Ghig Mhór celebrates the joy of putting on your first big hometown gig.

In each episode, a renowned Irish musician mentors an up-and-coming band and helps them to organise their first big gig in their hometown. From the sitting room to the stage, the series follows the bands as they attempt to find a venue, sell tickets and deliver the performance of a lifetime. An Ghig Mhór provides a platform to new emerging Irish bands and shines a light on the hard work, creativity and dedication that goes into putting on your own gig.

name: Reality Check
summary: It's time for a Reality Check! Join hosts Starr McGowan and Adrian Konarski every Friday for your bite-sized weekly roundup of everything jaw-dropping, binge-worthy and straight-up chaotic in the world of reality TV. We'll have you up to date on all the goss in no time.

name: Опасный
summary: To avoid being unfairly accused of murder and to improve his reputation, police Major Alexei Gorbatov, nicknamed Gorbaty, agrees to lead an experimental police unit consisting of former prisoners. These criminals have specific skills that are useful for infiltrating the criminal environment without the need for a long cover. In the process of completing tasks, the Hunchback is faced with a difficult moral choice and the need to control dangerous subordinates who can break down at any moment and let him down.

name: The East Palace
summary: A man who walks the spirit world and a court lady who hears the dead enter the East Palace by the king's orders — can they unravel its dark secrets?

name: Had I Not Seen the Sun
summary: Notorious serial killer Lee Ren-yao receives an interview from a documentary crew, triggering a string of mysterious events tied to a buried past.

name: Giada In My Kitchen
summary: Star chef Giada De Laurentiis has cooked in countless kitchens worldwide. To her, the kitchen is the heart of the home. Giada will team up with A-List designer Erik Garcia to surprise a deserving family with the kitchen makeover of their dreams. Their combined expertise leads to kitchens that are as beautiful as they are functional, transforming the lives of these families forever.

name: Shifty
summary:
This series shows in a new and imaginative way how over the past 40 years in Britain extreme money and hyper-individualism came together in an unspoken alliance. Together they undermined one of the fundamental structures of mass democracy - that it could create a shared idea of what was real. And as that fell apart, with it went the language and the ideas that people had turned to for the last 150 years to make sense of the world they lived in.

As a result, life in Britain today has become strange - a hazy dream-like flux in which no one can predict what is coming next. While distrust in politicians keeps growing. And the political class seem to have lost control.

previousepisode.name: Part Five - The Democratisation of Everything

name: We Were Tomorrow
summary: Evelyn & Noah navigate through 3 lifetimes to unearth the truth about their destiny with Warrick and Siena, but their efforts to flee the dying world become complicated when Cain, an immortal, decides to hunt them down.

name: Love Blossoms with the Wind
summary: When Song Qiyue returns from abroad, her dream homecoming collides with a harsh reality: inheriting a failing homestay on the brink of collapse. Teaming up with Gu Ci'an and his friends, they wage a revolution in hospitality. From financial disaster to unexpected triumph, their journey proves that the greatest rewards aren't just profit, but passion, purpose, and the power of belonging.

name: Aile Saadeti
summary: Telling the story of the events that develop when three unfamiliar families start living together, Family Felicity will bring family relationships, confrontation with the past and bonds of love to the screen with a humorous language.

name: Monster Lab
summary: After a scientist dies in a house fire, his assistants Katz and Uno are forced to move to a different house. One day they stumble upon a familiar book left by the scientist.

previousepisode.name: Chapter 10: That's How You Become A Businessperson

name: Tilda Apfelkern
summary: Tilda Appleseed is a small white church mouse. She loves her friends, delicious food and picnics. Every day is a wonderful day in Tilda's charming little village, where greater and smaller adventures await its inhabitants.

name: Faith & Fire
summary: Chen Tianshuang, having seen his buddy die right in front of him, chooses to leave the National Security system and become a humble fishmonger. However, he is recalled and sent to Taiwan, China, to infiltrate the local gang and uncover the smuggling routes. Upon arriving in Taiwan, China, he quickly adapts to the local lifestyle and social circles. Yet, the brutal gang wars and the harsh reality of his undercover mission are quietly looming ahead...

name: Blossom through the Cloud
summary: After becoming a top pilot, Ruan Sixian reunites with Fu Mingyu as love, ambition, and misunderstandings test their bond.

name: Остаться друзьями
summary: Roma and Anya were married for about five years, the candy-bouquet period was replaced by the harsh everyday life of family life. They realized that they had to move on, but in different directions. However, their mutual friends — young parents Katya and Lyosha, as well as bachelors Oleg and Elya — disagree with their decision to divorce, because Roma and Anya are the core of their party, without them the company will fall apart. Dinners together, trips to nature, shared birthdays — all this may come to an end. But Roma, apparently, has not cooled his feelings for his ex-wife. The casual phrase "I don't like it, let's get divorced" turned his usual lifestyle around. Anya alone, feeling free, plunges into the maelstrom of new relationships and tries to find herself in this world.

name: The Killer You Know
summary: Shocking tales of betrayal and murder.

name: Celebrity Puzzling
summary:
Get ready for Celebrity Puzzling, where your favourite celebrities battle tricky puzzles in a showdown of logic, speed and sheer determination.

Hosted by the ever-charismatic Jeremy Vine, every night sees quiz queen Carol Vorderman and beloved actor Sally Lindsay lead two celebrity teams into a battle of mind-bending puzzles and challenges.

But who will crack the code and claim victory, and who will be left scratching their heads at the back of the class?

name: Koupen-chan
summary:
Around you,

It affirms the little things in everyday life.

Baby emperor penguin

"Koupen-chan" is here.

Gently praise and embrace with soft warmth

The story of Koupen-chan and friends

name: The Reaper Princess Saves the Day
summary: The mischievous daughter of the Underworld King nearly brings chaos to the Netherworld after devouring all the Yin energy. As punishment, the King sends her on an adventure in the human world.

name: Shi Ba Sui Tai Nai Nai Jia Dao, Chong Zheng Jia Zu Rong Yao
Vamp
summary: To succeed as a singer, Natasha sold her soul to Count Vladimir Polanski who, when discovering her love story with Jonas in a past life, began to chase them.

name: Agatha Christie's Tommy & Tuppence
summary: Tommy and Tuppence are a detective duo for the ages. They fall in love, fall out of it, and tumble back in, all while solving some thrilling, entertaining mysteries along the way.

name: Vereda Tropical
summary: The story revolves around the conflicts between the families of Silvana and Oliva, mother and paternal grandfather who fight for custody of Zeca after the death of the child's father.

name: Chispita
summary: It is the story of a tender little girl who is separated from her mother after losing her memory in an accident. Isabel, known as "Chispita," is taken to an orphanage and later adopted by a widowed businessman to brighten his daughter's life. This radical turn of events will completely change our protagonist's life.

name: hundkatzemaus
summary: The series deals with topics relating to pets and animals in human hands. In each program, owners of pets or exotic animals as well as experts such as animal trainers, animal photographers, zoologists or scientists are visited. The special features and characteristics of the species, the requirements for keeping them and the particularities of caring for them are discussed with them. There are also practical tips on animal-friendly husbandry and/or product tests for pets in service articles.

name: Cat's Eye
summary: Working at the café by day, three sisters lead a double life as Cat's Eye, the elusive art thieves.

name: Andrea Celeste
summary: Andrea Celeste tells the story of a fifteen-year-old girl whose mother has disappeared. Her life unfolds between a orphanage and a wealthy home that adopted her, but where she is not loved.

name: Faro
summary: It's winter in the Algarve and little is happening. But, in the shadows, a Real Estate Fund is buying the entire island of Faro to build a luxury resort there. However, an unexpected obstacle appears: Zé Maria, an old fisherman, owner of a famous beach restaurant, refuses to sell, under the influence of his daughter, Ana Cristina, who, in the meantime, returns from Switzerland. And his example is followed by other inhabitants of the island.

name: Театральная зона
summary: The director of the Tula Youth Theater arranges a truly fiery premiere... and ends up in prison for setting fire to the theater. The only way to get out early is to stage "Romeo and Juliet" by assembling a troupe of prisoners and guards. The irreconcilable enmity between the two clans turns the rehearsals into absurd skirmishes, and the stage into a battlefield. In addition, Shakespeare gives a chance for freedom not only to the director, but also to the new actors who are secretly planning an escape.

name: Halva Malmö består av killar som dumpat mig
summary: Hopelessly optimistic but eternally single, 30-something Amanda decides to break her celibacy streak and throw herself into dating.

name: Eat, Sleep, then Wait for Happiness
Spring Fever
summary: Starting with the corruption case in Ningzhou, this story follows Ye Qinglan, the daughter of a disgraced official now enslaved after her family's downfall, and Shen Que, the young lord of Xuan Manor who operates in secrecy to investigate the truth. Together, they embark on a thrilling journey to unravel a dangerous conspiracy.

name: Tales of Five Immortals
summary: Orphaned in the chaos of the Republican era, Laifu survives a "fox spirit massacre" and hones his mystical skills in a derelict temple, becoming a wandering mystic. A decade later, his quest for vengeance begins with the "Weasel Immortal Wedding" case, entangling him with the enigmatic Miss Bai and her wealthy family's intrigues. As bizarre cases plague Harbin, Laifu joins forces with the resolute Inspector Gu to investigate. A shocking revelation at the Bai family reunion exposes the true mastermind behind the "grey immortal" possession. The very traitor murdered his master! Together, they dismantle the Bai family's sinister fortune-altering array and uncover a traitorous scheme involving a troupe leader colluding with the Japanese. Justice is served, but Laifu forsakes his newfound wealth for a life on the road. Both the willful Miss Bai and the spirited Inspector Gu choose to accompany him, transforming the Five Immortals Conspiracy into a tale of chivalry, where the end of one blood feud marks the beginning of new bonds...

name: Amanecer
summary: The plot centers on Leonel Carranza, a landowner whose kindness has been eclipsed by betrayal. After his wife's abandonment and his daughter's tragic death in a fire, Leonel seeks revenge. Convinced that Alba Palacios and her family are responsible for the tragedy, he forces her into a loveless marriage.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Nos aferramos al amor

name: Rainha da Sucata
summary: Maria do Carmo makes a fortune with her father's business and becomes a successful businesswoman, but maintains the habits of her humble past.

name: Lie Detector: Truth or Deception
summary: Lie Detector: Truth or Deception examines individuals long suspected of serious crimes who voluntarily submit to taking a polygraph test hoping to clear their names in the eyes of their family and community. Award-winning investigative journalist Tony Harris hosts, bringing critical context and analysis drawn from his background in criminal justice reporting, and the results of a professionally administered lie detector test by George Olivo, Former FBI agent and veteran polygraph examiner.

name: Koi ni Mudaguchi
summary: Nishina, Maya, Shiro, and Aoi are four good friends in their second year of high school with good looks but disappointing personalities. The four who decided that they will never fall in love, formed their own club, known as the "Muda-bu" (Useless Club), which focuses on researching silly themes and uploading them on social media. One day, they decided to do an experiment from a manga that says, "If you run with a piece of bread in your mouth and bump into someone, you will fall in love". While trying to conduct the experiment, they accidentally bumped into someone while having a piece of bread in the mouth.

name: Mentiras, la serie
summary: After discovering that Emmanuel Mijares has died, Daniela, Dulce, Yuri, and Lupita are summoned to a mysterious mansion. Forced to interact, the tensions between them quickly ignite, and the lies they've been hiding for years come to light. But little by little, these women begin to question themselves, to reflect, and to realize that they share much more than they ever imagined.

name: Deadly Kin
summary: This series retells intriguing true crime stories of families gone wrong – when divorce is just not enough, when problem parents must be silenced forever, when offspring become too much.

name: Catch Me If You Can
summary: Catch Me If You Can is a gripping true crime documentary series that delves into the chilling world of murderers who eluded capture, meticulously planning their crimes, and engaging in psychological warfare with investigators. Each episode takes viewers on a rollercoaster ride as they follow the pursuit of a different elusive killer, exploring the intricate mind games they play to outsmart those tasked with bringing them to justice. In this true crime docuseries, the focus is very much on the chase. With a blend of first-hand accounts, expert analysis, and stylized recreation, this series offers an unprecedented look into the methods and systems used by the police to finally capture these murderers.

name: I Want You to Say I Love You
summary: Ueda Itsuki is a 39-year-old single pharmacist. She had landed the job she wanted, enjoyed romance, and lived a peaceful life. However, her long-time boyfriend, Sawada Masakazu, got engaged to another woman... Sawada was someone Itsuki truly loved, but she couldn't express her feelings honestly and couldn't blame him so she wouldn't be hated. One day, on the way home from a drinking party with her colleagues, a younger man, Matsushige Eito, appears in front of Itsuki, and they suddenly start living together. Then she meets Sato Kohei, a medical representative who gives her peace of mind with his straightforward love and kindness... She starts to realize the true meaning of her happiness and the importance of being loved by someone, and something begins to change inside Itsuki...

name: California Avenue
summary: California Avenue is a story brimming with humour and love. Set in a secluded canal-side caravan park deep in the luscious English countryside, its peace is irrevocably disrupted by the arrival of Lela and her 11-year-old child, both on the run, looking for refuge in this hidden world. It is here that a fractured family will come together, ghosts and demons will firmly be put to rest and an unexpected love is forged.

name: Dream Beyond
summary: The story is about Chinese students at the prestigious Ivy League college. The efforts they made to get accepted, when just being gifted students isn't enough; their experiences, struggles, relationships, and the blend of Chinese-Western cultures while studying there. Gu Nian planned to study abroad because she wanted to be with her foreign boyfriend for a long time. Without any experience in studying abroad, she enrolled in a studying abroad agency, LZ, on the net but had a dispute with the company's owner, Lin Yao, and her boyfriend, Zhuo Peng. The reason was that Lin Yao took Gu Nian's order even though the company was short of staff. Zhuo Peng, who was a legal entity but did not work in the company, was forced to become Gu Nian's temporary tutor and helped her become a university student. Shortly afterwards, Lin Yao and Zhuo Peng broke up. Zhuo Peng was hired as a psychological counselor at the University of A. He found that the international student community has some psychological, life, and academic problems due to the uncomfortable environment. That's why Zhuo Peng set up a free consultancy service to help students find the right school for them. This goal also coincided with Gu Nian's. In the end, they became partners and a couple.

name: Squatters
summary: Squatters are taking over homes across the country and Flash Shelton is the man who gets them out. With bold tactics and street smarts, Flash and his team face tense and sometimes dangerous situations to help families reclaim their property. Each episode reveals the emotional and high-stakes battles where the fight for justice can quickly escalate, putting everyone involved at risk. This is the struggle to take back what rightfully belongs to them.

name: ATEEZ 8 FACE
summary: The world's first documentary that closely follows the real faces of ATEEZ.

previousepisode.name: San & Wooyoung's Project: Aim for it! Everyone gets it right! Umaibo Tasting Championship

name: Betrothed to My Sister's Ex
summary: Marie, the second daughter of a poor baron's household, is treated like a servant by her parents. Even at Marie's birthday party, her beautiful elder sister, Anastasia, is the star. Outside, Marie bumps into Count Kyuros Granado, who falls for her at first sight. Yet, due to a misunderstanding, the Count proposes to Anastasia. After a tragic accident, Marie must marry the count instead!

name: Captivated, by You
summary: Joji Ema goes to an all-boys school. After the school's athletic festival, Ema's eccentric classmate Miyoshi Hayashi starts acting bizarrely towards him. Yuichi Medaka goes to a coeducational high school. He ends up sitting behind Akira Nikaido, an unsettling student most of the school doesn't like. Explore an omnibus of stories about what it's like to be young.

previousepisode.name: Nikaidou Behind Me: Terrifying School Trip Ver.

name: Welcome to the Outcast's Restaurant!
summary: When superstar adventurer Dennis gets booted from the world's strongest party, he teams up with runaway Atelier to serve up his true passion—delicious cuisine. But this not-so-average eatery has not-so-average patrons. Dennis will battle his quirky customers' troubles with his trusty butcher knife and wok. Visit Adventurer's Restaurant and fill up your heart and stomach!

name: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
summary: Yu Ayase's mother Subaru is gifted with beauty, athleticism, and intelligence, but Yu seems to have only inherited his mother's good looks and nothing else. When Yu is enrolled into a high-class school, he is entrusted to the care of his mother's friend, and moves to their house. There, he begins rooming with the three Mikadono sisters, who are all exceptionally talented in their own way, but have a weak side to them.

name: Ab in die Ruine!
summary: In this show, the actors try to renovate and redesign a home with the external appearance of a building site to make it more attractive. In doing so, they take the renovation work into their own hands and become active as craftsmen.

name: Aybsiz
summary: A young doctor, convicted of murder, joins forces with his friends from the orphanage to prove his innocence and expose a syndicate that is framing innocent people.

previousepisode.name: The Gem from Xdinary Heroes Gaon That Made the Bald Top Gay Headbang Like Crazy | Hong Seok-cheon's Jewelry Box Season 4 EP.38

name: Modern Kadın
summary: Pınar, from a traditional family, tries to build an independent life in Istanbul while working as an assistant brand manager at a food company. Though she seems strong, she quietly longs for love, a promotion, and to discover her true self.

name: I'm the Most Beautiful Count
summary: Prince, a superstar in the entertainment industry, proudly comes out as LGBTQ and finds great success in her career. But everything changes when he suddenly wakes up in a past life—as Khun Worradej, a young man forced to hide his true identity in a time when same-sex love is forbidden. Prince must navigate palace intrigue, political betrayal, and uncover the mystery behind Worradej's past and his secret lover. On the journey, he encounters King Chaiyachet, a young monarch facing an assassination plot, and Mom Kosol, the king's older brother who holds a hidden truth tied to Worradej's heart. Prince must protect them both while challenging unjust laws against same-sex love amidst betrayal, rebellion, and the struggle for power.

name: Let's Go Karaoke!
summary: The president of the chorus club, Satomi Oka, is approached by a yakuza named Kyoji Narita. Kyoji's yakuza group holds a customary karaoke competition, and whoever earns the title of worst singer must get a tattoo. Since he was asked to be Kyoji's singing teacher, Satomi has no choice but to go along with these practice sessions. Brought together by karaoke, where will Satomi and Kyoji end up?

name: Private Tutor to the Duke's Daughter
summary: After failing the royal court sorcerer exam, Allen finds himself stuck with no job, no money, and no way home. Just as all hope seems lost, he's offered an unexpected position: private tutor to the daughter of one of the kingdom's most influential nobles, Duke Howard. His student, Tina, is a prodigy in every academic field, except magic. With the Royal Academy's entrance exams looming and magical ability a strict requirement, Allen must uncover the mystery behind Tina's magical block. Using his unorthodox teaching methods and a deep understanding of sorcery, Allen may be her last chance… but is there more to this assignment than he was told?

name: Ruri Rocks
summary: High schooler Ruri Tanigawa loves shiny things. She loves them so much that she heads into the mountains to search for crystals herself—where she unexpectedly meets Nagi Arato, a graduate student studying mineralogy. As the pair start collecting minerals together, Ruri begins developing a genuine appreciation for science and the beauty of the natural world.

previousepisode.name: Look Up, Examine, Search! And Next!

name: See You Tomorrow at the Food Court
summary: Meet Wada, who gives off an unapproachable vibe, and Yamamoto, who strikes fear into those around her because of her looks. Though the two girls attend separate high schools, they meet up at a shopping center's food court almost every day. Take a little peek at the laid-back afternoons Wada and Yamamoto share as they reflect on the ups and downs of high school life together.

previousepisode.name: Randy / Gorilla Tape / Toxic Fan / See You Tomorrow at the Food Court

name: Kamitsubaki City Under Construction
summary: Seven years after humanity was devastated by a major disaster, a beacon of science and prosperity rises in Kamitsubaki City. But lurking in its shadows are Tesseractor monsters born from human darkness. Only the Witchling, five girls with Song of Purification, stand against them. With every note, they fight, not just to protect the peace of the city, but to heal a broken world.

name: Twenty Twenty Six
summary:
Having previously held a leadership role on the London Games of Twenty Twelve and a spell in W1A as the Head of Values at the BBC, Ian Fletcher is now bound for the greatest stage in world football.

Next year's tournament will be the biggest ever. Hosted by the USA, Canada, and Mexico with 48 countries taking part and 16 venues thousands of miles apart across the whole of North America; what could possibly go wrong? Ian Fletcher is about to find out, as he joins the Twenty Twenty Six Oversight Team in Miami as its Director of Integrity.

name: Roasted: Verdens Sjoveste Ferie
summary: Linda P has invited 5 of Denmark´s funniest comedians on a holiday in sunny Marbella. Along she brings a suitcase with embarrassing ammunition from the comedians ‘past. Every evening, they take turns in the hot seat to get roasted by their colleagues. It´s a war of words with lots of surprises and laughs - because how far can you really go when it comes to jokes?

previousepisode.name: Jeg kan ikke unde de andre at vinde

name: Roast on the Coast - Sverige
summary: Kristoffer Appelquist has invited five of Sweden's funniest comedians to his luxury villa in Cyprus. During the daytime, they soak up the sun and enjoy the pool, but in the evening, things heat up as the guests, one after another, must take their place in the hot seat and get roasted by their friends. The last of them is the host, only to decide then who has become the best roaster of the season.

previousepisode.name: Som Ronald Mc Donald om han sålt UNHAPPY meals!

name: Roast On the Coast - Norge
summary: Six Norwegian comedians have packed their bags and traveled to Cyprus for a week of sun, swimming - and roasting! Each night, a new comedian will take the hot seat to have their life torn apart by the other comedians before the best roaster of the night is crowned. On the final day of the stay, the week's best roaster and the winner of Roast on the Coast -Norway will be announced.

name: 50 оттенков брака
summary: A comedy series about saving family relationships. The lives of Andrei and Kristina Konovalov have long been mired in the mundane, losing their vibrant colors, and the family hearth has completely extinguished. At the suggestion of friends, the couple turns to sex coach Boris and enrols in the course 'Sexual Resurrection'. During the training, Andrei and Kristina immerse themselves in experiments that seem strange, amusing, and some even frightening, pushing them out of their comfort zone. During the 'resurrection' process, the couple realises that their intimate life is just a small part of the puzzle, and the real problem of their faded relationship lies much deeper.

name: My Brilliant Career
summary: Sybylla is a shockingly modern young woman with one searing ambition - to be a writer, while her family is determined to marry her off. With an irrepressible taste for fun, Sybylla breaks every convention of 1900 Australia as she searches for a story that will allow her to write her way to independence. For her, the choice between adventure or marriage seems easy, until she falls in love. Will Sybylla marry, or will she risk it all for a creative life?

name: Top End Bub
summary: Top End Bub revisits Lauren, a dynamic Indigenous lawyer ticking off life goals in Adelaide. She's married to Ned, a handsome husband who makes fresh croissants. What else could a person need? After Lauren's eight-year-old niece is orphaned, the show follows the couple reluctantly abandoning their big-city goals and moving to the Top End (where the outback meets the tropics) to raise the child. While Lauren and Ned juggle the responsibility of becoming unexpected parents and try to keep their marriage together, Lauren must come to terms with her responsibilities within her culture as she transforms from an individualist to the linchpin of her family.

name: ClaireBell
summary: A woman wrongfully convicted for drug possession seeking refuge and falling in love with a solitary inmate with a rumoured brutal murder charge.

name: Future Fantastic
summary: A series of documentaries looking at the connection between science fiction and science fact.

name: Naturen vender tilbake - rewilding
summary: For a long time, many species have been so scarce that they are hardly ever seen. Humanity has wiped out over fifty percent of all mammals, birds and fish in as many years. Across Europe, efforts to restore the balance of ecosystems damaged by the human footprint are now seeing returns of many wild animals close to extinction. But not everyone is happy with their return.

name: Das NRW-Duell
summary: Game show with Bernd Stelter, in which celebrities from North Rhine-Westphalia are tested on their knowledge of their own federal state.

name: Kill Lupercal
summary: Kill Lupercalis the first animated series set in the Horus Heresy on Warhammer TV. It takes place in the dying days of the Siege of Terra – the most brutal and iconic battle in all of Warhammer.

name: Dating Game
summary: Hill, a former bullied boy with a geeky personality, finds love and confidence from "Yuka" in the female character romance simulation game "Yuka! Love Me Please" and grows into a handsome programmer beyond recognition. Hill achieves his dream of getting a job at the company that developed "Yuka! Love Me Please", where he meets Junji, the perfect, cold-hearted CEO from Japan. Soon after getting the job, the company announces that it will be ending service for the game, leaving Hill dejected. Seeing his passion to move forward despite his heartache, Junji approaches Hill with a proposition.

name: As You Stood By
summary: When two women plot to end an abusive marriage through murder, an unexpected visitor arrives — threatening to shatter everything they've carefully planned.

name: Три сигмы
summary: If you remember our podcast "This is the signal", then it's the same format, only now you can also watch the episodes. If you don't remember, we're envious that this is the first time you'll hear science journalist Ivan Shunin and N+1 editor—in-chief Alexander Dubov discuss science fiction in every sense with a specially invited guest and find out how science fiction is scientific.

name: N + Offline
summary: Lectures and other events from the N + 1 edition

name: DC Metal Force
summary: DC Metal Force is a miniseries about Justice League. A mysterious entity has brought the powers of good and evil together to participate in the ultimate super-powered showdown!

name: Batman Exordium
summary: After his parents are murdered, young Bruce Wayne vows to find their killer, but his quest leads him into conflict with Gotham City. Alfred Pennyworth tries to protect Bruce from criminals, corrupt police, social climbers, relatives.

name: A Journey to Glow
summary: In a war-torn world divided by rival states, rumors of a hidden royal treasure in the southern town of Yongxing draw together five unlikely strangers: a thief, a disgraced official, a loyal general, a tomb-guarding lady, and a struggling heir. As they search for the treasure to revive the local economy, they discover healing, purpose, and the true value of human connection.

name: Piao Yang Guo Hai Lai Song Ni
Big Backyard Quiz
summary: A series of games and quiz rounds explore the people and history of Australia, exactly the way people weren't taught in school.

name: Living Black
summary: Australia's premier Indigenous current affairs program, Living Black provides timely, intelligent and comprehensive coverage of the issues affecting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians.

previousepisode.name: Nornie Bero: Torres Strait On A Plate

name: Eternal Joy With You
summary: In her past life, Xu Wanning was betrayed by her husband. The child she raised was his mistress's, while her own son died tragically. Now reborn, she's determined to protect her son and take revenge. Amid her mission, she repeatedly crosses paths with Pei Heng, who is investigating the "Red Zhen" perfume. Soon, she realizes their connection began long before this life.

name: Heavenly Secrets Bureau
summary: The son of a convicted astronomer from the Imperial Observatory follows the clues left in his father's secret notes. Teaming up with the Ninth Princess, a skilled healer, they unravel a series of bizarre cases involving witchcraft, divine lightning, and earth-shattering sorcery. But as they peel back the layers of mystery, all signs point to a prophecy in the mysterious tome —the prophecy that says, "Two Fish Doom the Nation."

name: Sweet Secrets
summary: Lu Huayan, the star performer of the Paramount, comes to seek revenge for her sister. She encounters Li Motong from another world called "Wujian." In his quest to find a treasure that can make "Wujian" eternal, he must kill the mortal songstress Lu Huayan. Unexpectedly, he discovers she is his lover from a past life. Thus begins a tale of intertwined love and hatred, where passion and vengeance collide.

name: Starlit Bloom
summary: Gu Liusu, the founder of a jewelry brand, is decisive and efficient at work, and just as strict and meticulous in her personal life. Yet, one unexpected night, she ends up in a mix-up after a one-night stand with "Young Master" Lu Xingchen, a man she had only met once before. To make matters worse, Lu Xingchen soon joins her company as her personal assistant. Neither of these bickering rivals could have imagined that, with time, their relationship would undergo a profound change. Lu Xingchen develops an unspoken affection for the sharp-tongued yet soft-hearted Gu Liusu, while his design talent gradually earns her critical approval. As their souls resonate with one another, they find themselves falling deeper and deeper, swept away by the quiet yet powerful emotions that build in their daily lives together.

name: Returned Master
summary: On Chinese New Year's Eve, the entire household of the retired General Li is brutally slaughtered by a mysterious assailant. The youngest son, Li Jianwei, survives by a stroke of luck. Assuming a new identity, he infiltrates Ghost Valley, determined to exact revenge on those who destroyed his family. The valley's young heir, Chen Xiaoxi, is mischievous and unpredictable, yet gradually grows close to Li Jianwei, who tries every trick in the book to win his trust. Just when everything appears to be going according to plan, Li Jianwei begins to uncover disturbing secrets lurking behind the massacre. The supposed enemies are in fact the Zhongyong Army, once loyal soldiers branded as outlaws twenty years ago. The honor and reputation of the Li family may not be as spotless as believed. As loyalty and betrayal, good and evil are repeatedly turned on their heads, and the truth from two decades ago comes to light, Li Jianwei and Chen Xiaoxi must face not only their hidden pasts but also the weight of their fates. How will these two young men choose their paths when vengeance and identity collide?

name: The Crush
summary: Modern CEO Lin Yuhao suddenly finds his consciousness transported into the tea merchant game he developed, now inhabiting the body of Wei Xiaotang, a new bride of the Li family. The only way back to his world is to complete the game's mission and win the title of "World's Best Tea." Thus, Wei Xiaotang joins forces with her husband Li Zixuan, embarking on a journey filled with witty schemes and steadfast kindness to claim the ultimate prize.

name: Vengeance of the Mountain God
summary: Jin Shisan, adopted son of the famed ginseng hunter Jin Buhuan, masters the art of harvesting the prized root. When his entire clan is slaughtered during a mountain expedition, he alone escapes, only to be captured and forced into a life of brutal servitude as a "blood slave." After enduring years of torment, he breaks free. Now, he returns to the Mount Guan Dong, setting a deadly trap to hunt down those who destroyed his family...

name: Her Feast
summary: After being framed and tortured to death, Zhang Wange miraculously wakes up three years in the past. Armed with memories of her past life, she gets close to police captain Lu Ye, whose prophetic dreams offer eerie guidance, to uncover the truth. As the mist of illusions clears, Lu Ye surrenders to the devastating truth. When a bullet pierces two hearts in a dream, one remains trapped in the past while the other leaps toward the future...
